neighbours.label: Dense, weak '-' pole: no single trigger. Its top examples are a mix of Russian prose, Chinese text, code, base64 and English; the peak tokens are scattered (on, greeted, Accepted, enclosure, honored, guest). Fires on about 23% of tokens at 0.1 of max, so it is closer to a positional or background signal than a token feature.
